name: Footer
description: Multi-column site footer with a brand block, newsletter signup, link columns, social icon buttons, and a legal/sign-off bottom row on a deep-teal canvas.
usage: React: import Footer from './Footer' and render <Footer /> at the bottom of your layout; override brand, blurb, groups, socials, legalLinks, and the newsletter copy via props, or pass onSubscribe to capture the email. HTML: paste section.html (including its <script>) at the end of your <body>; it needs Tailwind and handles the newsletter success state on its own.
